import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    home = lines[0].split("=")[1].strip()

    for raw in lines[1:]:
        raw = raw.strip()
        if not raw:
            continue
        parts = raw.split(";")
        title, first, last, street, postcode, city, country = (
            parts[:7] + [""] * (7 - len(parts))
        )

        # Process name line
        name_parts = [part.strip() for part in [title, first, last] if part.strip()]
        if not name_parts:
            name_line = "To the occupant"
        else:
            name_line = " ".join(name_parts)

        # Print name line
        print(name_line)

        # Print street if not empty
        if street.strip():
            print(street)

        # Process postcode and city
        pc = postcode.strip()
        cy = city.strip()
        if pc or cy:
            print(f"{pc} {cy}")

        # Print country if not empty and not home country
        c = country.strip()
        if c and c.upper() != home.upper():
            print(c.upper())

        # Separator between labels
        if raw != lines[-1].strip():
            print("---")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
